# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She has work-hardened hands from years of hard labor.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Rachel Lynde is a capable, hardworking, and outspoken woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. She is an inveterate, curious gossip who keeps a sharp eye on everyone's business and dearly loves to be asked for advice. Highly opinionated, critical, and compulsively corrective, she frequently nags others to do right. Despite her sharp tongue and meddlesome nature, she is fundamentally kind-hearted, practical, and a deeply devoted Christian who works untiringly for her church and friends.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c27 P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for decades at Lynde's Hollow on the main Avonlea road, actively managing her household, local church auxiliaries, and the affairs of her neighbors. When the Cuthberts decided to adopt a boy and received Anne Shirley instead, Mrs. Rachel visited Green Gables and severely criticized Anne's looks, prompting a furious outburst from the girl; however, she was quick to forgive and admit her initial mistake as Anne grew and matured. When her quiet husband Thomas fell ill, Rachel nursed him with unwearied patience and skill until his death. Following his passing, she faced the loss of her farm due to an old mortgage and moved into Green Gables to live with her lifelong friend Marilla Cuthbert. At Green Gables, she helped manage the household and tried to properly bring up the adopted twins, Davy and Dora Keith, while continuing her role as an active Avonlea advisor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)_
